title: Creatio is an Exhibitor at the Gartner® IT Symposium/Xpo™ 2026 in Orlando
summary: Creatio joins business and technology leaders to explore AI CRM, agentic automation, and the future of enterprise work
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale —is an Exhibitor at the Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo™ 2026 and will attend the conference October 19–22 in Orlando, Florida.


The event brings together CIOs and IT executives to explore the technologies and strategies shaping the enterprise. This year’s agenda includes agentic AI, AI technology and infrastructure, cybersecurity, emerging technologies, and operating models.


We believe, Creatio’s participation reflects a core pillar of its approach: people and AI agents working together across customer and operational workflows. At the conference, Creatio will connect with business and technology leaders to discuss practical approaches to AI adoption and how organizations can translate AI investments into everyday business value.


Creatio brings AI CRM and workflow automation together on a single platform, helping organizations embed AI into sales, marketing, and service. AI agents can work alongside teams to automate routine tasks, improve customer engagement, and increase productivity, while no-code tools help organizations adapt their workflows as business needs evolve.


For CIOs and IT leaders, this approach supports the move from individual AI projects to broader enterprise adoption. Creatio enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage AI agents across business workflows, with governance and control to support adoption at scale.


While being an Exhibitor, we feel, Creatio supports the exchange of ideas and experience that helps organizations put AI into practice and transform how work gets done.


To learn more about the event and explore the agenda, visit the[Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo™ website](https://www.gartner.com/en/conferences/na/symposium-us) .

**About Creatio**


Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. Headquartered in Boston, MA, with a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
